accepted.label: Maximin Criterion
accepted.description: Choose the alternative with the best worst-case payoff (maximize the minimum for profits, minimize the maximum for costs). This conservative approach guarantees a minimum outcome.
coverage_criteria: Apply the maximin criterion to a payoff table to select the alternative with the best worst-case outcome.
Explain the conservative/pessimistic philosophy behind the maximin rule.
accepted.merge_rationale: Both candidates teach the same core maximin concept: selecting the alternative with the best worst-case payoff. Despite different labels and depth tags (application vs definition), the descriptions and coverage criteria are functionally identical, covering application to payoff tables and the conservative philosophy. They are same-level duplicates and are merged into a single teachable idea.
